name: cavalier_of_gales_dies_you_scry_your_own_library
notes: Printed: 'When this creature dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.' YOU scry (CR 701.18a: look at the top two cards of YOUR library). Both scry answers are 'bottom'. The opponent's library is untouched: its two named top cards stay on top, in order, above the six fillers. Your library holds the shuffled-in Cavalier and your six fillers (seven cards; their order after the mandated shuffle is not asserted).
